newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct crude, natural gas output up.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct crude, natural gas output up.

text.p: China's crude oil production rose 6.07 percent in January to October to 131.8954 million tonnes, compared to the same 1995 period, the Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
Crude oil production in October alone was 13.7117 million tonnes, the bureau said.
Natural gas output totalled 16.495 billion cubic metres in the first 10 months, up 15.67 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.
October gas production was 1.713 billion cubic metres.
